title: Our board
about: The placed 52 × 45 mm hexagon, every part from the Sierrathon BOM.

rows.check: Every schematic part is placed and on the BOM
Footprint package matches the BOM part number
Manufacturer footprint used (not a library stand-in)
rows.detail: J1: footprint USB_C_Receptacle_HRO_TYPE-C-31-M-12, part needs MFR:UJ20-C-H-G-SMT-TR; SW1: footprint SW_SPST_TL3342, part needs MFR:PTS526SM15SMTR2; SW2: footprint SW_SPST_TL3342, part needs MFR:PTS526SM15SMTR2; SW3: footprint SW_PUSH_6mm, part needs MFR:D6R90F2LFS

rows.check: Every schematic pin is on the right net (schematic ↔ PCB)
No connections that are not on the schematic
LED polarity (cathode to GND)
U3 land pattern = manufacturer (UltraLibrarian)
Preferred land pattern (IPC nominal / manufacturer), not a variant
Every 3D body sits inside its own courtyard
No two courtyards overlap, so no two bodies can collide
Pads and bodies are on the board (inside the outline)
Every drilled hole is at least 8 mil
Every part has a 3D body model
rows.detail: J1: no 3D model in the library

rows.check: BOM quantities match the designator lists
Inner copper: stack-up agrees with instructions
rows.detail: stack-up 5/10 oz vs instructions 10/10 oz; ask the fab (both readings meet 62 mil ± 10 %)

rows.check: Stack-up thickness within 62 mil ± 10 %
90 Ω pairs use the stack-up geometry (5/4 mil), all other nets ≥ 6 mil
rows.detail: a single global 6 mil DFM rule would wrongly flag these 6 nets

rows.check: LED current within the RP2040 default 4 mA drive
rows.detail: 330 Ω gives up to 4.945 mA: GPIO17–23 must be set to 8 mA drive (or 430 Ω)

rows.check: AP2112 junction temperature < 125 °C
USB clock exactly 48 MHz
QSPI clock within W25Q128 limit
